title: Interactive Fiction world authoring schema
description: World schema 2, flat JSON5 authoring. See docs/model-attributes.md.

description.title: Description
description.description: String or named text alternatives. Alternatives require default; selectors return IDs.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

text.title: Text
text.description: Unconditional string, or ordered strings/named segments. Controller selects named segments; no code is evaluated.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

paragraphs.title: Paragraphs
paragraphs.description: String or array of paragraphs; a paragraph may itself contain named segments.

prose.description: Entity-owned named prose; no automatic fallback between owners.

items.description: Object definitions keyed by persistent ID; nested declarations establish ownership.
Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

startScreen.title: startScreen
startScreen.description: Opening screen; omitted world field becomes a screen with the world title.

title.description: Heading; falls back to world title.

kicker.description: Short text above heading; falls back to subtitle.

scenery.title: scenery
scenery.description: Room-local examinable feature. Use an ordinary object for other actions.

name.description: Inline name; falls back to title, then ID.

title.description: Examination heading; falls back to name, then Examine.

examined.description: Examination progress; engine sets true when examined.

exit.title: exit
exit.description: Connection keyed by destination room ID. Empty definition is valid.

before.description: Text before destination link; default wording describes an exit.

description.description: Optional wording used to derive display parts; prefer before/after.

listed.description: Include in automatic exit list; does not remove topology.

door.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

standingOn.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

room.title: room
room.description: Room definition; name and description recommended, empty items/exits inferred.

name.description: Display name; recommended for objects shown to players.

imageUrl.description: Local image asset path. Object images do not automatically get a separate browser panel.

exits.description: Destination room IDs mapped to exits.

scenery.description: Room-local features; IDs cannot contain a colon.

wearable.title: wearable
wearable.description: Wear/remove settings. Boolean true also enables wearing.

removeMessage.description: Feedback when removal is refused; ordinary refusal when omitted.

insertion.title: insertion
insertion.description: Special insertion/swipe for the item ID used as dictionary key.

retain.description: Leave item held after use; the held object retain flag also applies.

connection.title: connection
connection.description: One connection target, keyed by object ID.

connected.description: Initial connection state; connecting clears other targets.

disconnected.description: Initial progress flag set by disconnection.

connectable.title: connectable
connectable.description: Connection capability; movement disconnects owned objects.

targets.description: Object IDs mapped to connection settings.

readable.title: readable
readable.description: Enables Read, which consumes one turn; does not set a read flag.

noteSources.description: Recording sources offered in the reading dialog; omitted means none.

searchable.title: searchable
searchable.description: Search capability; sets searched and consumes a turn.

pullable.title: pullable
pullable.description: Resets this object’s pushable.pushed state. Requires it to be pushed.

climbable.title: climbable
climbable.description: Standing-on capability; ordinary movement requires climbing down unless the exit declares standingOn.

climbed.description: Initial climb state; engine also maintains player posture.

message.description: Climb feedback; ordinary wording when omitted.

pressable.title: pressable
pressable.description: Enables Press; effects belong in rules, except a declared transport control.

transport.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

stop.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

dwell.description: Updates to wait before selecting another transport request.

edible.title: edible
edible.description: Eating reports outcomeText; consumed controls deletion and turn cost.

consumed.description: Delete item and commit a turn when eaten.

tool.title: tool
tool.description: Held tool capable of named operations.

capabilities.description: Story-defined capability names, such as cut.

toolOption.title: toolOption
toolOption.description: Named control for a matching tool; controller handles the action.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

capability.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

tool.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

record.title: record
record.description: Creates a note prototype in an accessible owned open notebook.

container.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

entry.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

label.description: Suffix for default Make a note label.

onExamine.description: Offer recording in direct examination controls.

choiceOption.title: choiceOption
choiceOption.description: Named submenu option; handling belongs in chooseOption rules.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

choice.title: choice
choice.description: Named interaction control; handling belongs in choose rules.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

input.title: input
input.description: Text input control; submitInput rules handle acceptance.

notesOnly.description: Hide free-form input; allow recorded values.

failureConsumesTurn.description: Charge a turn for generic rejection.

passage.title: passage
passage.description: Enter interaction using the current room’s declared exit.

destination.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

missionStates.title: missionStates
missionStates.description: Names used by the controller to describe mission phases.

outbound.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

searching.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

returning.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

routeEdge.title: routeEdge
routeEdge.description: Actor route edge; room graph is independent of player restrictions.

to.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

transport.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

missionDestination.title: missionDestination
missionDestination.description: Actor visit keyed by mission ID. Completion prevents ordinary repeat requests.

room.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

departure.description: Varied report passages; no report when omitted.

departureReply.description: Varied report passages; no report when omitted.

arrival.description: Varied report passages; no report when omitted.

finished.description: Varied report passages; no report when omitted.

missions.title: missions
missions.description: Actor mission routes and base visits. Put exceptional durations and conditional reports in controller rules.

home.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

idleState.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

blockedReport.description: Reports when no route is available.

npc.title: npc
npc.description: An actor is an ordinary object with npc configuration, not a separate top-level collection.

state.description: Story-defined initial state; author explicit values needed by rules.

nearbyDescription.description: Description when in an adjacent accessible room.

room.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

transportStop.title: transportStop
transportStop.description: A stop outside the boarding room.

room.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

transport.title: transport
transport.description: Independent physical transport. Occupants live in the boarding room’s ordinary collections.

stops.description: Nonempty unique room ID list, or stop IDs mapped to room definitions.

items.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

stop.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

achievement.title: achievement
achievement.description: Definition keyed by achievement ID. Controller explicitly awards it.

encounter.title: encounter
encounter.description: Message shown before an ending; acknowledgement reveals the ending screen.

ending.title: ending
ending.description: Ending definition. Controller chooses when to end play.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

clockNotice.title: clockNotice
clockNotice.description: Message when elapsed minutes cross a threshold.

clock.title: clock
clock.description: Optional clock controls; timed actions still cost minutes without this object.

player.title: player
player.description: Player initial state; owned objects are definitions, not lists of IDs.

room.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

visitedRooms.description: Optional previously visited room IDs; current room is marked on initialization.

object.title: object
object.description: Composable flat capabilities. ID comes from the collection key. No object fields are universally required; name and description are recommended. Additional JSON fields are explicit game state.

name.description: Display name; recommended for objects shown to players.

imageUrl.description: Local image asset path. Object images do not automatically get a separate browser panel.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

article.description: Grammatical article, such as a, an or the.

fixed.description: Prevents taking; cannot combine with portable true.

hidden.description: Hidden object and its contents are inaccessible.

scenery.description: Suppress automatic object listing; still supports ordinary actions.

weight.description: Controller data only; no built-in capacity limit.

container.description: Enable containment; does not imply openable or opened.

supporter.description: Enable visible holding; implies opened true.

door.description: Door state used by exits; incompatible with container/supporter.

openable.description: Offer opening/closing; requires container, supporter or door.

opened.description: Initial open state: omitted becomes false for openable objects, true for supporters, otherwise remains absent. A non-openable container needs opened true to expose contents.

lockable.description: Support locking/unlocking; does not imply openable.

locked.description: Initial lock state; requires lockable true and cannot combine with opened true.

key.description: Key object ID; requires lockable true. Omitted means keyless manual locking/unlocking.

accepts.description: Ordinary placement whitelist. Omitted or * allows any item; [] allows none.

transparent.description: Closed contents are visible AND accessible; ordinary Put still needs opened.

takeLabel.description: Removal label; Take for supporters, Take Out for containers.

insertable.description: Item IDs mapped to insertion/swipe controls; overrides ordinary placement for that item.

openMessage.description: Optional feedback; ordinary engine wording when omitted.

closeMessage.description: Optional feedback; ordinary engine wording when omitted.

lockedMessage.description: Optional feedback; ordinary engine wording when omitted.

lockMessage.description: Door feedback override. Container handlers use standard feedback; change it with a report rule.

unlockMessage.description: Door feedback override. Container handlers use standard feedback; change it with a report rule.

wearable.description: Boolean true enables wearing, or use removal settings.

turnedOn.description: Initial switch state; does not enable switching alone.

recordable.description: One or more notebook recording choices.

textValue.description: Recorded input value; controllers may compare against it.

textInputTargets.description: Permitted device IDs; omit to allow reachable configured devices.

world.title: world
world.description: JSON5 authoring model before normalization. Custom state is allowed; engine relationship validation runs after schema validation.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

schemaVersion.description: Optional world schema identifier; independent of package version.

items.description: Prototypes for later creation; absent means empty.

achievements.description: Definitions keyed by achievement ID; absent means empty.

imageVariant.title: imageVariant
imageVariant.description: Controller configuration: first eligible image variant wins.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

imageVariant.$comment: Controller configuration or runtime state; not an authoring capability.

cue.title: cue
cue.description: Controller configuration: room cue or observation; text comes from model prose.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

cue.$comment: Controller configuration or runtime state; not an authoring capability.

exitVariant.title: exitVariant
exitVariant.description: Controller configuration: first eligible exit wording variant wins.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

exitVariant.$comment: Controller configuration or runtime state; not an authoring capability.

actorCueVariant.title: actorCueVariant
actorCueVariant.description: Controller configuration: ordered actor report alternative.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

actorCueVariant.$comment: Controller configuration or runtime state; not an authoring capability.

movementCue.title: movementCue
movementCue.description: Actor movement report. Initial unconditional description may be authored; construct conditional variants in controller.

turnCue.title: turnCue
turnCue.description: Actor turn reports. Construct conditional alternatives in controller.

intermittent.description: Allow gaps and ambient replacements for repeated reports.

missionVariant.title: missionVariant
missionVariant.description: Controller configuration: exceptional mission duration and report override.

id.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

missionVariant.$comment: Controller configuration or runtime state; not an authoring capability.

predicateReference.title: predicateReference
predicateReference.description: Controller configuration: named predicate for delayed work, registered in every game instance.

predicate.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

predicateReference.$comment: Controller configuration or runtime state; not an authoring capability.

transportRequest.title: transportRequest
transportRequest.description: Controller request / runtime queue entry; use requestTransport to create it.

destination.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

actor.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

event.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

transportRequest.$comment: Controller configuration or runtime state; not an authoring capability.

timer.title: timer
timer.description: Runtime item timer; use startTimer to create it.

event.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

timer.$comment: Controller configuration or runtime state; not an authoring capability.

scheduledEvent.title: scheduledEvent
scheduledEvent.description: Runtime scheduled job; use schedule.afterTurns to create it.

event.description: Persistent entity or variant ID; references remain strings.

scheduledEvent.$comment: Controller configuration or runtime state; not an authoring capability.

runtime.title: runtime
runtime.description: Engine-maintained save metadata; do not author.
runtime.$comment: Controller configuration or runtime state; not an authoring capability.
